The background appears to be a smooth surface, possibly a canvas or a piece of paper, which serves as a base for the colorful mixture. The colors are not evenly distributed; instead, they form swirling patterns with distinct blobs and streaks. The red color is particularly prominent, appearing in small, round shapes that stand out against the lighter and darker hues.
